"''Things have changed.|Vance and a Duros|}} '''Vance''' was a [[human]] [[deputy]] under [[Niro]]. At some point, Vance mentioned to Niro that [[bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane]] was once their best friend, only for the [[alien]] to reply back that [[time]] has moved on. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== Vance appeared in "[[One Good Deed]]," the sixth episode of the [[2025]] [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld]]'', which premiered on [[May 4]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/tales-of-the-underworld-announce|text=Two Favorite ''Star Wars'' Bounty Hunters are Back for ''Tales of the Underworld''}} Vance was voiced by [[Oscar Camacho]]. ==Appearances== *{{TOTU|One Good Deed}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|url=GkywNANueew|text=Tales of the Underworld | Official Trailer | Available May 4 on Disney+}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Vance}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=ვენსი }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Police]]
